- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant created a marketing plan for a small snow removal business, outlining strategies such as identifying the target market, developing a USP, creating a website, utilizing social media, offering seasonal packages, partnering with local businesses, running promotions, and investing in local advertising.
